```sql
SELECT AVG(t."Amount") AS segment_avg_single_transaction_amount
FROM main."transactions_1k" t
JOIN main."customers" c ON t."CustomerID" = c."CustomerID"
WHERE c."Currency" = 'EUR'
  AND c."Segment" = 'LAM'
  AND t."Date" BETWEEN '2012-08-23' AND '2012-08-26';
```
